description: Fixed prices for a European / cross-Channel transfer from London or the UK to a continental city (e.g. Ghent, Bruges, Paris, Brussels, Amsterdam, Cologne, Milan, Barcelona), i.e. for destinations outside the UK. Returns per-car-type prices, fixed per vehicle and final, including the Eurotunnel crossing. If the city is not configured, the result has found:false and lists the available EU destinations; the office confirms a price for other cities on request.

car_type.description: Optional single EU car type (Standard, Electric, People Carrier, Executive, Large PPL, Executive PPL, Minibus, Luxury). Omit for all car types.

hub_code.description: Nearest UK departure hub for the UK leg: LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY, SOU. For a London pickup use LHR.

title: Get European Transfer Quote
